posture: The bulk of the public corpus snapshot written by `tos-access public-corpus-build` (README.md): its pages, exact-surface indexes, document manifests and analyses, kept in R2 under docs/STORAGE.md. Git holds this digest manifest and the snapshot's own manifest.json, retained.json, revisions/ and mappings/, which name these files by their digests. `node bonsai/lib/layers.mjs fetch access/public-corpus` brings the files into a checkout.

rights.basis: Only explicitly public, publication-authorized packets covered by the selected digest-bound rights records pass the build; each document's source items and rights records are bound in its document manifest and in the selection.
